Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-15

1. Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
Google announced a global rollout of Gemini 4 Hydrogen, its latest multimodal AI model, integrated directly into Google Search to deliver more helpful, visual, and intuitive responses.

2. Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
Google introduced the Gemini Decisions API, a developer‑focused service powered by the Gemini Decision model that delivers quick, calibrated decisions across text, images, and other modalities.

3. Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
Google has rolled out Gemini Intelligence to additional devices, adding new features that enhance productivity and creativity across phones, tablets, and wearables.
